tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.quote: If you are under 18 you may not legally use GenAI platforms without written parental permission. This includes Copilot, which is provided as part of the Microsoft365 suite.
The University does not recommend or endorse any specific GenAI tools.
Some tools, particularly those that are free to use, will request your permission to access and share user data.

data.quote: Do not enter personally identifiable or sensitive information into GenAI platforms. Some platforms store the interactions, which may constitute a data breach under the Data Protection Act and UK GDPR 2018. This includes research data.

legal.quote: Do not share others’ personal, identifiable, or sensitive information with GenAI platforms unless you have their express consent. If you do so, you may be in breach of the UKs Data Protection Act 2018 and Europe’s GDPR laws.
This means that, when using GenAI without proper accreditation, you could inadvertently plagiarise or breach the copyright of someone’s work.
